audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: she owns lane phases with safe Q poke and E spacing, Veigar edges first item and wins clean at two-plus. WR 52.85 Veigar over 1807 games supports slight owner favour overall despite her lane control. Packet flags the chart-vs-WR tension; scaling profile explains it (she wins lane, he wins game).
All four content spikes present and grounded: her 3-5 Q-E control, her level 6 Frozen Tomb + self-ult sustain, the even first-item skill check, Veigar's two-item takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart rows 0-4 said 'Skill' while content win[] and packet say Lissandra; breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; enemyWin templated; the Frozen Tomb self-cast (untargetable + heal — never R into it) missing from the full layer; anti-heal unmentioned; 20 misgender hits; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 — her engage and escape in one button, and she is immobile that whole window. Ring of Frost roots at 10s but only 450 range. Self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable and heals, which eats a mistimed Primordial Burst; Grievous Wounds blunts the tomb heal.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 moved to Lissandra with grounded whys and ratings (win[] already agrees — side-only per the chart rule); cooldowns rewritten with 24s/10s/20s; tomb-untargetable rule written into dosFull[1].d; Oblivion Orb added to itemization; bleed bullets replaced.
